capabilities: Drag time blocks onto day, week, and month boards
Store time entries in task frontmatter
Track scoped day, week, and month totals
Export selected tasks and date ranges to CSV
Show activity statistics and calendar heatmaps
extras: Detailed controls live in an in-app guide (question mark in the task panel or the 'Open Chronoboard guide' command); the README's Month View section is empty.
problem: Obsidian has no visual board for planning and tracking time spent on tasks across day, week, and month views.

relations.evidence: Chronoboard works well with TaskNotes-style task notes

summary: Gantt-style timeboard that turns Markdown tasks into draggable time blocks and writes time entries into task frontmatter.
